rows.source_title: Estonian Tax and Customs Board: Income from lease and rent, licence fees (last updated 21.11.2025)
rows.label: Rental income and pension income (renditulu; pensionid) [national]
rows.value: 22%; 20% flat deduction on residential rent; pensions after the EUR 776 pensionable-age exemption. Paid by individuals. Tulumaksuseadus § 16 and § 19.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident
rows.source_title: Estonian Tax and Customs Board: For non-residents, Income from employment (last updated 14.11.2025)
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (mitteresidendi palgatulu) [national]
rows.value: 22% withheld; basic exemption only for EEA residents with a residence certificate. Paid by non-resident employees. Tulumaksuseadus § 29 and § 43.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: social-employer
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Maksumäärad ja maksuvaba tulu suurus, tab 2026
rows.label: Social security contributions: social tax and unemployment insurance (sotsiaalmaks; töötuskindlustusmakse) [national]
rows.value: Employer social tax 33% (monthly minimum base EUR 886) and unemployment insurance 0.8%; employee unemployment insurance 1.6%. Paid by employers and employees. Sotsiaalmaksuseadus; Töötuskindlustuse seadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B2
rows.source_title: Estonian Tax and Customs Board: For non-residents, Income from employment (last updated 14.11.2025)
rows.label: Employer levies: income tax and social tax on fringe benefits (erisoodustusmaks) [national]
rows.value: Income tax 22/78 of the benefit plus 33% social tax on the benefit and that tax. Paid by employers. Tulumaksuseadus § 48; Sotsiaalmaksuseadus § 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: fie
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Füüsilisest isikust ettevõtjale (FIE): Sotsiaalmaks (last updated 14.04.2026); FIE sotsiaalmaksu avansiliste maksete tasumine; Maksumuudatused 2026. aastal (27.11.2025); Riigi Teataja: Sotsiaalmaksuseadus § 2 lg 1 p 5 and lg 5
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (FIE sotsiaalmaks) [national]
rows.value: 33% social tax on business income, with an annual minimum and a maximum base of 10 times the minimum wage. Paid by sole proprietors (FIE). Sotsiaalmaksuseadus § 2 lg 1 p 5.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Tulumaks ja maksuvaba tulu (last updated 09.01.2026)
rows.label: Contractor rules: employment test and withholding on contract fees (võlaõiguslik leping) [national]
rows.value: 22% income tax withheld and 33% social tax on fees under contracts for services; none for FIE business income. Paid by payers of contract fees. Töölepingu seadus § 1; Tulumaksuseadus § 41.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B4; detailed table: social-employee
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Kogumispensionide seadus (Funded Pensions Act), § 9 and § 66 lg 1 (version in force 01.11.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Mandatory funded pension (second pillar) (kohustuslik kogumispension) [national]
rows.value: 2% of pay (4% or 6% by choice), withheld by the employer. Paid by members born in 1983 or later. Kogumispensionide seadus § 9.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Maksumäärad ja maksuvaba tulu suurus, tab 2026
rows.label: Corporate income tax on distributed profit (juriidilise isiku tulumaks) [national]
rows.value: 22/78 of distributed profit; retained profit untaxed. Paid by resident companies and branches. Tulumaksuseadus § 4 and § 50.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Kohalike maksude seadus (Local Taxes Act), § 5 'Kohalike maksude loetelu' (version in force from 01.01.2025)
rows.label: Local business taxes: advertising tax, road closure tax, amusement tax, animal-keeping tax and parking charge (kohalikud maksud) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipal council where it levies them. Paid by businesses and residents. Kohalike maksude seadus § 5.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: entrepreneur-account
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Ettevõtluskonto (last updated 06.11.2026); Maksumuudatused 2026. aastal (27.11.2025)
rows.label: Simplified regime: entrepreneur account (ettevõtluskonto) [national]
rows.value: 20% of receipts (22/24/26% for second pillar members), up to EUR 40,000 a year. Paid by individuals with small business income. Ettevõtlustulu lihtsustatud maksustamise seadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Tulumaksuseadus (Income Tax Act), § 50 lg 1 and § 53 lg 1 and 4 (version in force 01.10.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits (kasumieraldised; püsiv tegevuskoht) [national]
rows.value: 22/78 on profit distributions and on profit withdrawn from a branch; no withholding on dividends. Paid by companies and branches. Tulumaksuseadus § 50 and § 53.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Maksukohustuslasena registreerimise kohustus (last updated 05.02.2026); Käibemaksumäärad ja maksuvaba käive (last updated 05.11.2025); Maksumäärad, 2026
rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (käibemaks) [national]
rows.value: 24% standard; 13% and 9% reduced rates; registration above EUR 40,000. Paid by consumers; collected by businesses. Käibemaksuseadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Kohalike maksude seadus (Local Taxes Act), § 5 'Kohalike maksude loetelu' (version in force from 01.01.2025)
rows.label: Local sales tax (müügimaks) [municipal]
rows.value: None: the local sales tax was repealed in 2012. Paid by no one. Kohalike maksude seadus § 5 and § 8.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise-environment
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Alkoholi-, tubaka-, kütuse- ja elektriaktsiisi seadus (Alcohol, Tobacco, Fuel and Electricity Excise Duty Act), § 56 and § 66 (version in force 01.11.2026–31.12.2026)
rows.label: Excise duties (aktsiisid) [national]
rows.value: Alcohol, tobacco, fuel and electricity; e.g. petrol EUR 591 and diesel EUR 428 per 1,000 litres. Paid by producers and importers. Alkoholi-, tubaka-, kütuse- ja elektriaktsiisi seadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Maksukorralduse seadus (Taxation Act), § 3 'Maksusüsteem' (version in force 01.11.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Digital services, insurance premium or financial transaction tax (digiteenuste maks; kindlustusmaks; finantstehingute maks) [national]
rows.value: None: not among the state taxes. Paid by no one. Maksukorralduse seadus § 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: excise-environment
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Alkoholi-, tubaka-, kütuse- ja elektriaktsiisi seadus (Alcohol, Tobacco, Fuel and Electricity Excise Duty Act), § 56 and § 66 (version in force 01.11.2026–31.12.2026)
rows.label: Energy taxes: excise on electricity (elektriaktsiis) [national]
rows.value: EUR 2.1 per MWh (EUR 0.5 for electricity-intensive businesses with a permit). Paid by electricity suppliers. Alkoholi-, tubaka-, kütuse- ja elektriaktsiisi seadus § 66.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Hasartmängumaksu seadus (Gambling Tax Act), § 1 and § 6 (version in force 01.03.2026–31.12.2026)
rows.label: Gambling tax (special consumption tax) (hasartmängumaks) [national]
rows.value: EUR 1,406 per gaming table; EUR 300 per slot machine plus 10% of net stakes; 22% of lottery sales; 5.5% of net remote gambling stakes. Paid by gambling operators. Hasartmängumaksu seadus § 6.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Maamaksuseadus (Land Tax Act), § 5 'Maksumäär' (version in force from 01.01.2026)
rows.label: Property tax: land tax (maamaks) [municipal]
rows.value: 0.1% to 2.0% of the taxable value of land a year, set by each municipality; buildings untaxed. Paid by landowners and land users. Maamaksuseadus § 5.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Riigilõivuseadus (State Fees Act), § 74 and § 76 (version in force from 2026)
rows.label: Property transfer tax (kinnisvara võõrandamise maks) [national]
rows.value: None; the land register state fee depends on the transaction value (EUR 110 up to EUR 102,260; 0.16% above EUR 639,120, at most EUR 2,560). Paid by buyers (state fee). Maksukorralduse seadus § 3; Riigilõivuseadus § 74 and § 76.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E3; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Maksukorralduse seadus (Taxation Act), § 3 'Maksusüsteem' (version in force 01.11.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Wealth tax (varamaks) [national]
rows.value: None: not among the state taxes. Paid by no one. Maksukorralduse seadus § 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: Estonian Tax and Customs Board: Estate (last updated 07.10.2025)
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (pärandimaks; kingimaks) [national]
rows.value: None: inherited property is not taxed on receipt. Paid by no one. EMTA, Estate; Maksukorralduse seadus § 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Mootorsõidukimaksu seadus (Motor Vehicle Tax Act), § 12 and § 14 (version in force 01.01.2026–31.12.2026)
rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (mootorsõidukimaks) [national]
rows.value: Annual tax: EUR 50 base plus CO2 and mass components, reduced with age; registration fee on first registration. Paid by vehicle owners. Mootorsõidukimaksu seadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F1
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Maksukorralduse seadus (Taxation Act), § 3 'Maksusüsteem' (version in force 01.11.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Heavy goods vehicle tax (raskeveokimaks) [national]
rows.value: Quarterly tax on heavy goods vehicles by mass and axles (rates not stored). Paid by owners of heavy goods vehicles. Raskeveokimaksu seadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: excise-environment
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Keskkonnatasude seadus (Environmental Charges Act), § 19 (version in force 01.07.2026–30.06.2027)
rows.label: Environmental charges: CO2 pollution charge (saastetasu) [national]
rows.value: EUR 25 per tonne of CO2 for heat producers outside the EU emissions trading system. Paid by heat producers. Keskkonnatasude seadus § 19.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Kohalike maksude seadus (Local Taxes Act), § 5 'Kohalike maksude loetelu' (version in force from 01.01.2025)
rows.label: Tourist or accommodation tax (turismimaks) [municipal]
rows.value: None: not among the local taxes municipalities may levy. Paid by no one. Kohalike maksude seadus § 5.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Maksukorralduse seadus (Taxation Act), § 3 'Maksusüsteem' (version in force 01.11.2026–30.11.2026)
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax (lahkumismaks) [national]
rows.value: None: not among the state taxes. Paid by no one. Maksukorralduse seadus § 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: Estonian Tax and Customs Board: From a third country to Estonia (last updated 27.10.2026)
rows.label: Customs, import VAT and traveller allowances (tollimaks, impordi käibemaks) [EU and national]
rows.value: EU tariff; EUR 3 per item on parcels up to EUR 150 from July 2026; EUR 2 handling fee per item from November 2026; import VAT 24%. Paid by importers and travellers. EU Customs Code; Tolliseadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Riigilõivuseadus (State Fees Act), § 74 and § 76 (version in force from 2026)
rows.label: Administrative fees: state fees (riigilõiv) [national]
rows.value: State fees for official acts (e.g. land register entries by transaction value); no stamp duty on documents. Paid by persons requesting the act. Riigilõivuseadus.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu seadus (Estonian Public Broadcasting Act), § 7 lg 5 and § 11 (version in force from 01.10.2026)
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (teleluba) [national]
rows.value: None: public broadcasting (ERR) is financed by a state budget allocation. Paid by no one. Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu seadus § 7.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Estonia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Siseministri määrus nr 82 'Pikaajalise viisa andmise, viibimisaja vormistamise ja viibimisaja pikendamise kord ja tähtajad ning piisavate rahaliste vahendite määr' (version in force from 22.05.2026), § 15 lg 7; Välismaalaste seadus § 62^5; 2026. aasta riigieelarve seadus § 2 lg 5 p 5; Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet: Long-term visa
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa and new residents (expat regime) (viisa kaugtöö tegemiseks) [national]
rows.value: No expat regime; digital-nomad visa holders become tax resident after 183 days in 12 months. Paid by remote workers and new residents. Välismaalaste seadus § 62^5; Tulumaksuseadus § 6.
